description: Doc-derived, hand-written Bash failure and abort-shaped failure; not recorded from a live session.
sanitized_by: Hand-authored with fixture placeholders; checked by fixtures_lint.rs and reviewed against SANITIZE_CHECKLIST.md.
notes: No live capture was available. All commands, error text, ids and timing are hand-written examples, not observations. The docs show a non-zero Bash command delivering PostToolUseFailure with tool_input, tool_use_id, error, optional is_interrupt and duration_ms. The true flag models a failure delivered as an abort; cancelling a running tool does not necessarily fire this hook. No exit code is extracted from error text. Legacy no-result records are unchanged.
